description: The weekday remarks of a train's punctuality detail («Il martedì è in orario 0 volte su 4, peggio della media»): the weekdays with at least minimumWeekdaySamples samples whose on-time share, against the train's own limit, is at least minimumWeekdayGapPoints points from the stop's share, the largest difference first, the earlier weekday on a tie, at most maximumWeekdayRemarks (contracts/shared-data/v1/punctuality-v1.json). Each reader parses the file `document` names (the statistics format of docs/data-sources/PUNCTUALITY_STATS.md, synthetic) and asks the remarks of the train numbered `number` at its stop `stop`.

cases.why: a Frecciarossa measured at 5 minutes (12 of 20, 60%): Tuesday at 0% (60 points) first, then Wednesday and Friday at 100% (40 points each), the earlier weekday kept; Thursday at 75% (15 points) is a fourth; Monday has 3 samples, too few
a regional train measured at 15 minutes (10 of 20, 50%): Monday at 100% and Friday at 0% differ by 50 points each, the earlier weekday first
a stop that publishes no weekdays has no remark
15 points from the stop's share (80% against 65%) are enough; 5 points are not
